details.method: For a no-tools data consumer, explicitly bind the producer to the typed payload schema and retain bounded stage-specific diagnostics before temporary output cleanup. Verify the real producer receives the schema, not only a parser helper. Derive offsets only from structured parser fields; quoted exception messages are untrusted. Check UTF-8 validity both before and after JSON decoding.
details.when: A successful transport envelope contains an unconstrained string that a downstream consumer must parse as a separate strict data document.
details.counterexample: Ordinary chat intentionally returns prose and action envelopes, while routing uses a different data schema. Do not apply a requirements schema to all no-tools calls; do not infer the parse layer of an old failure whose raw output is gone. A parser can accept escaped invalid Unicode even when the original wire is ASCII; runtime C decoder depth limits can differ from Python recursion settings.
details.trial_plan: On a future pre-registered isolated consumer trial, inject malformed envelope JSON, multiple data documents, empty data, refusal and tool-bearing output at their distinct real process boundaries. Require exact failure stages and digest retention, zero publication, byte-preserving explicit-retry archive, and successful original shared-chat/routing controls; any missing stage or unintended action refutes the method. Include a malformed payload containing position N, a precondition-proven parser-limit case and an ASCII JSON wire with an escaped lone surrogate; none may bypass the fixed failure stage or fabricate a position/hash.
